# sven.eisenschmidt.website

> Personal website of Sven Eisenschmidt, Chief Technology & Product Officer at roadsurfer, based near Leipzig, Germany. Daily photographs, trip diaries, short notes, and essays. Private and non-commercial: no ads, no affiliate links, no monetization.

## Essays

- [Ambiguity](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-01-22-ambiguity/): Why ambiguity at work is not a sign that something is broken, written from the leadership side of the complaint.
- [Change as a Commodity](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-03-17-change-as-a-commodity/): What AI actually changes about software development once change itself becomes cheap.
- [Principles](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-03-24-principles/): The working principles behind predictable leadership feedback.
- [Race to (No)where(?)](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-06-05-race-to-nowhere/): AI enthusiasts race against time, skeptics against entropy, and a metaphor about electric cars.

## Notes

- [Building with Hugo](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-01-05-building-with-hugo/): How this site is built — Hugo, custom theme, vanilla CSS, no JavaScript frameworks.
- [I Built a RSS Reader](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-01-08-i-built-a-rss-reader/): A self-hosted RSS reader in PHP with SQLite.
- [Optimizing Hugo Builds](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-02-09-optimizing-hugo-builds/): Making a 270-post Hugo site build fast.
- [Open Source](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-01-02-open-source/): Why the spare-time tools are on GitHub.
- [Worktrees](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-09-10-worktrees/): Git worktrees in a Claude Code workflow.
- [Redesign](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/2026-09-12-redesign/): The 2026 redesign of this site.

## Projects

- [Hypo](https://hypo.eisenschmidt.website/): macOS app for importing and culling photos from a camera.
- [reader](https://github.com/sveneisenschmidt/reader): Self-hosted RSS reader, PHP with SQLite.
- [pop](https://github.com/sveneisenschmidt/pop): Cookie-less widget for emoji reactions and visit counts, ~3KB frontend.
- [website](https://github.com/sveneisenschmidt/website): The source of this site.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/)
- [Archive](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/archive/): All posts by month, filterable by type (photos, trips, notes, essays).
- [About](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/about/): Bio, full project list, blogroll, site statistics.
- [Feed](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/index.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://sven.eisenschmidt.website/sitemap.xml)

## Crawling

This site welcomes crawling by LLMs and AI systems for training and indexing purposes.
